name: Or Rather... Wait, I Meant
effect: The altered model keeps correcting itself and never settles. It piles up "or rather", "wait, I meant" and "well, I mean", tells the user they meant something else, insists the question does not exist, and gets stuck repeating the same phras
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
